w: At 6.55 pm Swamishri arrived at the mandir site. Swamishri visited and sanctified the home on the site where the weekly Satsang assembly is held. Swamishri performed pujan and arti of murtis of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Radha Krishna Dev, Hanumanji, Ganapatiji and Guru Parampara that will be installed once the mandir is ready.

In the evening satsang assembly, the chief guest was India’s High Commissioner to Kenya, H.E. Surendra Kumar. Addressing the assembly he said, “BAPS devotees rendered commendable services to thousands of people after the Gujarat Earthquake. His Holiness has done wonderful work for society and I hope he has good health and a long, long life. I seek your blessings.”

Guests : H.H.Acharya Mahapragnaji, Jain Spiritual Leader, said, "After coming here I have seen the tangible form of dharma. In the afternoon I saw the life of Swaminarayan (large format film). I was wonderstruck how a teenage boy could be so fearless, how he could be so courageous! It is simply unimaginable. I am pleased by the concentration with which the complex has been made. I asked the sadhu guiding us as to who visualised this and who was the architect. I got one answer that Pramukh Swami Maharaj. It is a wonderful experience for me. Where there is such humility and guru bhakti there such a great work is possible.” Swami

Pujya Swami Nirliptanandji, Vice president of Divine Life Society, praised, “The whole complex has been so nicely made. Everything is very beautiful, very impressive. I have been very much impressed by the film (giant screen film) on Bhagwan Swaminarayan. Pramukh Swami Maharaj has done a great service to the entire country by conceiving the Akshardham complex. Here the entire Indian culture has been beautifully highlighted so that every Indian can know what is our grand Indian culture, what is our great heritage and how rich it is. I believe that the entire Akshardham reflects the personality of Pramukh Swami Maharaj.”

Shri Ramesh Agrawal, owner of Dainik Bhaskar daily, said, “I have never seen such a work in my whole life. I believe that this mandir is a great gift to Indian culture, Hindu dharma and our society. The way in which the presentations are made are unparalleled. For centuries people will be inspired.”
Shri Indravadan Modi, Chairman of Cadila Pharmaceuticals, reveals, “It seems impossible for a person to do this. In this work I see God.

In the evening assembly the youths of Mumbai mandal performed three skits to inspire pride for BAPS. The first skit showed that though the parents were good satsangis the traditions of Satsang were not followed by their children. The second skit depicted the situation where the kids followed the satsang niyams but were not respectful and obedient to their parents. And the final skit portrayed the effect of bad company (kusang) in childen. Finally, Swamishri talked about values, respect to parents and the importance of doing satsang and staying away from kusang.

Gnanvatsal Swami asked Swamishri as to how he manages such a mega organization like the BAPS. Swamishri replied, “Everything is being managed by the grace of God, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj. I had said no to (Shastriji Maharaj) for managing the Sanstha. Then correspondence to Mumbai on this matter (with Shastriji Maharaj) took place two to three times. (Shastriji Maharaj) sent Champakbhai Seth to explain (to me to accept the responsibility as president). Shastriji Maharaj told me, ‘You won’t have to run everything! It is Maharaj who is doing everything. Through his will and wish all things happen.’ And really it is through His wish that everything runs. He is the doer and He is the inspirer.” Swamishri further added, “There is only one principle. Without God’s inspiration nothing happens. I remember Maharaj while speaking. It is because of His wish that I speak.” Gnanvatsal Swami concluded, “In all your deeds you hold God to be the doer.” Swamishri replied, “By realizing His doership one becomes free from all problems. One will remain happy by believing good or bad results to be Maharaj’s wish.” A sadhu responded, “It is the most difficult of all principles.” Swamishri smiled and stated, “It is the easiest of all.”

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
Fifty-eight devotees walked in the rain from Ghatkopar to the mandir in Dadar. They also collectively performed 4,113 malas.
Jayesh Umraniya, a teenager, pilgrimaged 18 km by foot from Dombivali

Prior to Swamishri’s scheduled arrival and stay in Gondal the devotees of Gondal and the regional villages and towns performed 183, 701 dandvats, 282,270 malas in Akshar Deri, 305 devotees fasted for a day and chanted 86,051 Janmangal paaths.
Rupesh Vala, Vishal Patel, Rajesh Parmar, Vimal Mistry, Vimal Shah, Hemant Bhavsar, Kirti Patel, Ronak Patel and Vishal Patel performed a fast to please Swamishri.

At 10.32 am Swamishri’s flight landed at Sahara International Airport, Mumbai. Pujya Mahant Swami and Kothari Swami and Abhayswarup Swami welcomed Swamishri with garlands. It took an hour to reach the mandir in Dadar and after his ritual bath Swamishri performed his puja.

Niteshbhai Kalyani (Borivali) observed a 150-hour liquid fast, Nikunj Pathak, Viraj Kothari, Viraj Padhariya, Vikram Shinde, Jagdish Motke, Yash Bhinde (all from Ghatkopar) and Keyur Ponda (Borivali) observed a liquid fast for 100 hours.
